changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO brands (id, name_uz, name_ru, slug, sort_order, is_active, is_popular, created_at, updated_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid()::text, v.name_uz, v.name_ru, v.slug, v.sort_order, true, v.is_popular, NOW(), NOW() FROM (VALUES ('Chevrolet', 'Chevrolet', 'chevrolet', 10, true), ('Toyota', 'Toyota', 'toyota', 11, true), ('BMW', 'BMW', 'bmw', 12, true), ('Mercedes-Benz', 'Mercedes-Benz', 'mercedes-benz', 13, true), ('Tesla', 'Tesla', 'tesla', 14, true), ('BYD', 'BYD', 'byd', 15, true), ('Volkswagen', 'Volkswagen', 'volkswagen', 16, false), ('Chery', 'Chery', 'chery', 17, true), ('Haval', 'Haval', 'haval', 18, true), ('Honda', 'Honda', 'honda', 19, false), ('Suzuki', 'Suzuki', 'suzuki', 20, false), ('Kawasaki', 'Kawasaki', 'kawasaki', 21, false), ('GAZ', 'ГАЗ', 'gaz', 22, false), ('KAMAZ', 'КАМАЗ', 'kamaz', 23, false), ('UAZ', 'УАЗ', 'uaz', 24, false), ('Isuzu', 'Isuzu', 'isuzu', 25, false), ('Volvo', 'Volvo', 'volvo-trucks', 26, false), ('MAN', 'MAN', 'man-trucks', 27, false), ('Ninebot', 'Ninebot', 'ninebot', 28, false), ('Giant', 'Giant', 'giant', 29, false), ('Trek', 'Trek', 'trek', 30, false), ('Stels', 'Stels', 'stels', 31, false), ('Mazda', 'Mazda', 'mazda', 32, false), ('Nissan', 'Nissan', 'nissan', 33, false), ('Mitsubishi', 'Mitsubishi', 'mitsubishi', 34, false), ('Lexus', 'Lexus', 'lexus', 35, false), ('Geely', 'Geely', 'geely', 36, true) ) AS v(name_uz, name_ru, slug, sort_order, is_popular) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM brands b WHERE b.slug = v.slug);
